Question
========
What is software-based text modification?

Answerlist
----------
* using software tools to detect plagiarism
* using software tools to disguise plagiarism
* using AI-generated content as author's own
* using software tools to format and proofread the text without acknowledging it


Solution
========
Software-based text modification means using tools to disguise plagiarism.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
